title: English Foundation
description: Designed for learners looking to build solid essential grammar rules, daily conversational vocabulary, and confidence in basic communication.
benefits: Mastery of core English grammar structures and tenses
Essential daily vocabulary and functional survival phrases
Confidence building in speaking and listening for everyday scenarios
Personalized feedback and guided practice exercises

title: English Intermediate
description: Perfect for individuals aiming to enhance fluency, articulate opinions clearly, understand complex texts, and handle professional and social interactions.
benefits: Expanded vocabulary range for professional and academic contexts
In-depth command of compound and complex sentence structures
Interactive discussions and debate sessions to boost spoken fluency
Practical reading comprehension and listening strategies

title: English Advanced
description: A comprehensive program for ambitious communicators focusing on nuanced expression, persuasive argumentation, business correspondence, and near-native proficiency.
benefits: Advanced idiomatic expressions, tone nuance, and precise diction
Mastery of high-level academic and executive business writing
Critical analysis of complex texts, articles, and presentations
Refined articulation for international meetings, interviews, and public speaking
